title: BBC World: Houthis say at least 25 killed in Saudi air strike
description:
BBC World reports that Houthis say at least 25 people were killed in a Saudi air strike. This is an attributed report, not an independently verified casualty count.

Source: BBC World, published 7 Nov 2026 at 17:09 UTC.
https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c65yn1v99ypmo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss
